evidence_notes: ASRS and EyeWiki have overlapping specialist authors and guideline references; counted as independent editorial syntheses, not independent trials. Moorfields treatment page broadly describes referred tears as high risk; the article preserves ASRS/EyeWiki distinction for asymptomatic low-risk atrophic holes and does not generalize the high-risk sentence to every hole. EyeWiki update-pending status and historical PPP citations retained.
